correctness.rationale: The final theorem uses exactly the specified cyclic A and B1,B2,B3 pairwise/triadic payoff tensors on the probability simplex, with 1<α≤2, 0<β≤1 and b>(2α−β−1)/4 so a*=(1+4b+β−2α)/(3+2α−β)>0. The original-time orthonormal chart X=(u1−u2)/√2,Y=(u1+u2−2u3)/√6 makes the linear real part −D(a−a*)/18, D=3+2α−β, and strictly positive ω. At a=a* the exact quartic equivariant field has only z,conj(z)^2,z²conj(z),z⁴,zconj(z)^3 monomials; their full coefficients are displayed and algebraically constructed from all three matrices by inspected check_hopf.py. The nonresonant quadratic term adds a purely imaginary correction −2i|Q|²/(3ω), so the genuine real cubic coefficient is ℓ=(1+b)(1−β)/(2D). For β<1, ℓ>0 with μ<0 when a>a*, producing a unique local repelling Hopf cycle, normal-form radius²=D²(a−a*)/[9(1+b)(1−β)]+O((a−a*)²). For β=1, exact full-quartic reversibility under (X,Y)↦(−X,Y) (not merely a vanished cubic) and positive angular velocity imply fixed-line half-turn returns, hence every sufficiently small nonstationary orbit is periodic: a true nonlinear center. The nondegenerate statement is not extended to β=1.
